registered: 2026-11-03 before campaign08 signal counts, probability calibration, or replay
question: Can control-theory persistence and a past-only drift-diffusion cost probability make the frozen $8 gate more robust to one-bar delay?
frozen_entry: Unchanged $8 gate action and readiness from fresh02 forecasts and cloud_fresh03_lineage decisions; no refit, threshold change, or new data splice. Reconstruct and exactly match frozen baseline replay before evaluating filters.
candidate_persistence: Keep an $8 gate action only when the immediately previous completed bar was contiguous, ready, and had the same nonzero $8 gate action. This is a two-bar hysteresis/debounce rule. Never use the next candle to confirm the current decision.
candidate_diffusion: For each gate action, require 32 contiguous completed closes ending at the signal bar. From their 31 one-minute differences compute sample mean mu and sample standard deviation s (ddof=1). Model the future ten-minute price sum with mean 10*mu and predictive variance s^2*(10+100/31), including uncertainty in estimated drift. Approximate stressed profitability by P(side*future_move > 3 index points) using the normal CDF; keep only finite s>0 and p>0.60. This is an assumption-driven forecast, not a calibrated probability claim.
primary_combination: Keep the gate action only if both persistence and diffusion rules pass at the completed signal bar. Also report each rule alone as registered controls; do not choose by observed P&L.
probability_diagnostic: On matured, contiguous evaluation opportunities with a frozen gate signal, compare diffusion p with whether the actual next-open to tenth-bar-close directional MNQ gross exceeded the $6 stressed round trip. Report Brier score and base-rate Brier control. This is not an independent calibration set and does not tune p>0.60.
execution: One MNQ contract, existing causal-v2 previous-bar-volume next-open fill and fixed ten-bar exit. Both immediate and one-bar-delayed signals; base/stress/extreme costs, occupancy, drawdown, session bootstrap, gap exits. Filtered signals and reasons stay private.
comparison: Identical-source unchanged $8 gate and no-trade $0. A candidate must improve stressed net under both delays and retain enough independent trade/session support, not just benefit from a few trades.
screen: At least 50 trades and ten active sessions on a source-audited window, positive stressed and extreme net under both fill timings, positive session-bootstrap lower expectancy, no dependence on unresolved gap exits, and later untouched confirmation. Already opened 2026 windows are development evidence only.
risk: No finite maximum drawdown provided; report it and leave live risk gate open.
deployment: Research only; no broker or live orders
